item.title: Massive Credential Breach Puts 149 Million Online Accounts at Risk
item.description: A sweeping leak of login credentials has exposed roughly 149 million user accounts tied to major online services, including Gmail and Facebook, in what security researchers describe as one of the largest credential compromises to surface so far this year.​
